source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In your Shooting phase, as this unit is picked to shoot by close-quarters shooting: its attacks against a unit engaged with it may disregard BS and Hit roll modifiers; and for each of its [BLAST] weapons, you may have that weapon lose [BLAST], in which case it can target only an enemy unit that no other friendly unit is engaged with.

detail.when: your Shooting phase, on being picked to shoot by close-quarters shooting

effects.attacks: against a unit engaged with this unit

effects.thenTargetRestriction: enemy unit not engaged with another friendly unit
